description: First replies to booking leads. Each opens with the listing and the price for the nights asked, states only what the profile records (a missing fact is a visible placeholder), answers in the lead's language, and ends on one question that moves toward a booking. A case without its own listing uses `listing`.

cases.name: free dates: the listing and the price for those nights, then one question

lead.text: Anyone with a 1br in Westlands from the 15th, 3 nights?

expect.text:
Hi Kevin! I have a 1-bedroom in Westlands, free Sun 15 Nov to Wed 18 Nov.
It has fibre Wi-Fi and backup power.
Ksh 9,000 a night, Ksh 27,000 for the 3 nights.
Photos: https://example.com/westlands-1br
Shall I hold them for you?

cases.name: a Swahili lead gets a Swahili reply

expect.text:
Habari Wanjiru! Nina 1-bedroom Westlands, inapatikana tarehe 15 Nov hadi 18 Nov.
Ina fibre Wi-Fi na backup power.
Bei: Ksh 9,000 kwa usiku, usiku 3 ni Ksh 27,000.
Picha: https://example.com/westlands-1br
Nikushikilie tarehe hizo?

cases.name: taken dates offer the next free window, for an agent's client

lead.text: Client needs a 1br in Kilimani 21st to 23rd

expect.text:
Hi! I have a 1-bedroom in Westlands for your client. Fri 21 Aug to Sun 23 Aug are taken, but it's free Tue 25 Aug to Thu 27 Aug.
It has fibre Wi-Fi and backup power.
Ksh 9,000 a night, Ksh 18,000 for the 2 nights.
Photos: https://example.com/westlands-1br
Shall I hold those dates for you?
